summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. (BIP) reported that its unitholders voted overwhelmingly in favor of the proposed corporate structure simplification at a special meeting held virtually on Oct. 14, 2026. The transaction converts BIP from a Bermuda-based limited partnership into a Canadian corporation, Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Inc. (BIP Inc.), with unitholders receiving Class A subordinated voting shares. Completion does not require BIPC shareholder approval, and subject to a final Supreme Court of British Columbia order, closing is expected before year-end 2026. BIPC's separately rescheduled special meeting is set for Oct. 29, 2026.
